scope: Static public demonstration startup only; Skill, state engine, native examples and published tag/archive unchanged
cause: The eager English iframe src started before the parent chose a version and locale; initial stage replaced that in-flight document, aborting case-data/v1.json and raising an uncaught fetch error.
repair: Start the iframe at about:blank. The existing stage function owns the first localized navigation and subsequent same-version scene reuse; ready/postMessage and actual error reporting stay intact.
requirements: Six fresh actual Chrome contexts per run, English and Chinese each three times
Hold each real child case-data response until the parent selected foundation; no synthetic ready events or sleeps
Exactly one localized viewer document navigation across foundation/run
Real rendered nodes, relations and recorded event in both scenes
Zero pageerrors and zero failed requests; no filtered abort exceptions

case_artifacts.message: 64 original archive sources, recorded cases, causal transfers and screenshots verified

ci_integration: Existing timeline-browser job adds build_site_viewer.py and test_demo_startup_browser.mjs; all prior steps and assertions remain.
